{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to The Dweller — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[The Dweller]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[The Dweller]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[The Dweller]]'s Engineer services at [[Black Hide]] in [[Wyrd]].

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' The Dweller's whereabouts are '''public knowledge'''.
* '''Invitation:''' Sell commodities at '''at least 5 unique Black Markets'''.
* Sell commodities at '''5 unique Black Markets'''.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Sell commodities at '''5 unique Black Markets'''.
# Travel to '''Black Hide''' in [[Wyrd]].
# Pay The Dweller '''500,000 CR'''.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with The Dweller.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[The Dweller]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
